dense.sourceMaskProjectionMethod: Nearest sample in the original 1520px mask, using COLMAP projection minus0.5px. Fused-point displacement and dense-pyramid sampling can change boundary membership; this does not replay library depth-map mask decisions.

mesh.limitations: Nearest-cloud distances describe graph-cut interpolation and coverage. They do not establish physical surface accuracy, occupied floor, collision or correct texture.

texture.method: Actual JPEG dimensions; calculated allocation for uncompressed RGB8 and hypothetical RGBA8 upload with full mip levels.
texture.limitations: These arithmetic texture allocations are separate from measured physical-device GPU memory and application startup transfer.

limitations: Four fitted original panoramas supply this diagnostic. Same-family held-out imaging has its own evaluation.
All geometry uses arbitrary scale. Physical floor, full-route coverage, night lighting and independent human recognition remain unqualified.
Dense fusion counts virtual images; this audit independently counts original physical frame centers.
Source-mask projection uses the original full-resolution mask and reports boundary differences separately.
